Oracle Fusion PPM – Project Accounting SME

Center of Excellence | Working alongside Tessera AI Agents

Location: US-based.

Remote: Hybrid: remote, with regular on-site work at customer offices and store construction

sites. Travel up to 30%.

Experience: 12+ years in Oracle project accounting, including 5+ years on Oracle Fusion Cloud

PPM

Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

Positions: 1

Reports to: VP, Center of Excellence.

Start date: Immediate.

Engagement model: Full-time, permanent Tessera role. The initial assignment is a program-

length, multi-wave legacy-to-Oracle Fusion PPM migration and implementation for a retail store

development program, expected to run 12 to 18 months, after which you move to the next

Oracle engagement. Works US business hours alongside the customers Corporate Accounting,

Construction, Real Estate and Procurement teams, the Oracle Fusion Financials consultant and

Tessera's distributed delivery team.

About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers

governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years

to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce,

Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera addresses the scope a system integrator would

have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI-native platform.

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations

have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and

business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for

Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile

in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a

coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and

lets teams work in plain English.
